caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of a central horizontal bar with two oval loops at each end, and two vertical side pieces attached perpendicularly, each with an additional circular loop, all rendered in shades of brown and gray indicating rust and aged metal. Attached to one side of the object is a length of interlinked chain composed of several oval metal links, which is tangled and has two large hooked ends. The drawing is detailed, with the texture and color variations of the rust and corrosion carefully depicted. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, with the artist’s name “ROSE CAMPBELL CERRÉ” written in small, fine letters beneath the object.
title: Bar Bit
